title: Check a reading's earlier-job references against the current repo
summary: Add a reading-acceptance check in athena-core: every earlier job id, path, role, or symbol the reading calls existing must be found in the current snapshot, or the reading must list it as a deliverable it creates. This addresses the cause shared by 5p65, 38jx and 02zf, where a reading assumed an unlanded artifact existed. The audience is Athena's reading stage and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New unit tests; fmt, clippy and test must pass.
Fix at the reading-acceptance gate, not per job.
Criteria run tests that show refusal and acceptance.
Enforced by a code check, not prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs holds build_reading (line 661), check_prior_result_and_scope (line 2563) and check_code_survey (line 3171). The new check is added beside them and called where the others are, after the reading is built and before it is accepted; the check rules run in that order and are unit-tested in the same file. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are untouched.

Root cause: nothing validates a reading's claims that earlier work exists. The new check, named check_existing_references, scans the reading text for symbols and paths the reading says already exist (backticked crates/ or docs/ paths, and names of roles, prompts and functions). It confirms each is present in the current snapshot, by file existence or a grep of the symbol. A path the reading lists as a create deliverable is exempt.

Earlier job ids named in the request: 5p65 (failed, not verified), 38jx (rejected, with a test failure from a low-disk guard that is environmental) and 02zf (failed, not verified). Their code-health and post-mortem work is not in this change and stays out of scope; their candidate files are excluded. The 38jx candidate's files (code_health.rs, code_health_hooks.rs, display.rs and others) are dropped, not kept.

A reference to an earlier job id is accepted only if the reading shows the artifact it relies on is in the snapshot; otherwise the reading must list it as a deliverable of this change or state it as out of scope. Which earlier jobs have landed is judged from the artifacts found in the snapshot, not from job state.
Refusal rule: the check refuses more readings and the higher refusal rate is intended. Expected 8% of newly refused readings, because past readings that cited absent artifacts are the failure class.

acceptance_criteria.text: The change description and CHANGELOG.md name the root cause as 'nothing checks a reading's references to earlier work against the current repo' and say it is fixed at the reading-acceptance gate in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, not per job.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: a new unit test shows a reading that calls a nonexistent path, role or symbol existing is refused, and the same reading is accepted when that item is listed as a create deliverable or exists in the snapshot. The test uses generic fixtures, not one job id, and fails when the check is removed.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: a test shows a reading whose references all exist in the snapshot is accepted, so the check does not refuse sound readings, and an empty reference list is not treated as a pass without scanning the text.
A Grep of crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs shows the new check function called from the same acceptance path as check_prior_result_and_scope, so every reading passes through it.
CHANGELOG.md records the new refusal rule with 'expected 8% of newly refused readings' and why such readings should be refused.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test`; all pass. Any failure from a disk-space guard is reported as environmental rather than treated as a pass.

out_of_scope: Re-building the code-health check of job 20261026-042558-5p65 and 20261026-064950-38jx; its candidate files are dropped.
The post-mortem field and retry-findings work of job 20261026-065228-02zf.
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow files.
Fixing the call-site inventory failures (brde, s7e2) beyond this reference check.
Changing prompt files, which have little token headroom.
departures: Lower pass probability: a new refusal rule on a large file needs careful false-positive control, and the gate is hard.
urgent_reason: Six jobs failed or were stopped at plan critique because readings assumed missing artifacts, wasting producer and planner attempts; refusing such readings early cuts these redo cycles.
hard_reason: It adds a rule that can refuse a reading at the reading-acceptance gate, a gate that judges every job.
